verses.73:14: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰ ا مَّهِيلًا

meaning: The root كثب primarily means to collect things together, often from a nearby place, or to pour something out. It can also describe scattering, like dust or grain, or a group of people gathering.
